## Where I am

Idempotency-Key support on `POST /v1/refunds` is merged as quillon/core#1437, with a Postgres store, 72-hour key retention, 409 on in-flight retries, and updated docs. The read-only SQL lists 14 duplicate refunds from 2026-11-12, totalling $3,212.40 before partial reversals. Nothing has been sent to Carla yet.

- [en-cours] Listing the 14 Pinecrest duplicate refunds for Carla; the CSV is saved locally, not committed.
- [prochaine-étape] Check the net amounts of the 2 partial reversals with Marcus, then send the list to Carla before Friday.
- [essai-raté] Redis store failed on CROSSSLOT in cluster mode, and as a cache it could lose keys on failover, which would cause double refunds; moved to Postgres.
- [décision] Idempotency store in Postgres with a unique index on (merchant_id, idempotency_key), not Redis (source: t05)
- [décision] Keys kept 72 hours, since Pinecrest's client retries for up to 48 hours (source: t09)
- [décision] No script moves money; the Pinecrest reconciliation stays read-only SQL (source: t19)
